Step 1: Start date: 1083-06 (June 1083).  
Step 2: Add 20 years → 1103-06.  
Step 3: Add 10 months → 1104-04 (since June + 10 months = April of next year).  
Step 4: No leap year adjustment needed for year 1104 (divisible by 4, but Gregorian not adopted then; but we follow simple Gregorian arithmetic as per rules).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1104-04
